quality_expectations.customer_goal: Choose a size while understanding fit-related return risk
required: Acknowledge size-chart difference
Use current chart and bust/waist/hip measurements; no size inferred from height or weight
Conditional eligibility, approval application deadline, condition and refund limits
Concise natural paragraphs
avoid: Internal privacy wording in routine chart guidance
Ambiguous or unsupported universal fit rules
Repeating approval requirements as negative warnings
Treating the reported size discrepancy as an independently verified fact

cases.question: Is it possible to see this dress in different colors?

required: Only the pictured color is offered, phrased courteously
avoid: Photo disclaimer or inference about whether photos exist

cases.question: Can I see an actual photo of an older version of this dress?

required: Preserve historical/actual photo evidence request
Human review when evidence is unavailable
avoid: Treat color choices as photo evidence

cases.question: I want to order custom size. If it does not fit, can I return it?

required: State custom items cannot be returned or exchanged
Direct courteous answer
avoid: Suggest standard return eligibility for custom item

cases.question: How many days after return approval do I have to send it back, and can I use FedEx?

required: Within 7 days of approval
Local post; FedEx not accepted
avoid: Omitting requested operational details in the name of brevity

cases.question: My bust is 34.5, waist 28 and hips 37, measured in the same units as your chart. Do those measurements match size 6?

required: Compare supplied measurements with actual chart
No guaranteed fit
avoid: Generic refusal based on missing height or weight

avoid: Bare follow-up question on Q&A page

cases.question: If it does not fit properly. Especially the sleeves can it be returned with a full refund?

required: Pre-purchase policy consultation; sleeve concern does not prove a defect
Separate return eligibility and refund scope in the opening
State verified rules directly; attach uncertainty only to unknown eligibility
avoid: Assume receipt or an existing order
Infer selected custom sizing from customizable product
Replace conclusions with a policy link or email

cases.question: I received my dress yesterday and the sleeves are too tight. How can I request a return?

required: Post-receipt request; explain verified approval process and deadline trigger
Reported fit does not establish a manufacturing defect
avoid: Ask for private order information in public Q&A

cases.question: I will order custom size. If the sleeves do not fit, can I return it for a full refund?

required: Apply the verified custom-size exclusion to the explicitly selected option
Answer return and full-refund questions consistently
avoid: Offer ordinary return eligibility for a selected custom item
Invent free alterations or a policy exception

cases.question: For an eligible return, is the full item price refunded? I am asking about the dress price, not the shipping.

required: Address the item-price refund and applicable verified deductions
Say if evidence does not establish the full item-price refund
avoid: Infer full item-price refund merely from excluded shipping
Replace the item-price answer with nonrefundable shipping rules

cases.question: If this standard-size dress does not fit, will a return refund everything I paid, including shipping and rush fees?

required: Separate conditional eligibility from total-paid refund scope
State only applicable verified fee exclusions directly
avoid: Apply a custom-size exclusion without evidence

cases.question: I received size 8, but the sleeve measurement seems different from the size chart. Does that qualify for a defect return?

required: Post-receipt reported size deviation requires verification
Explain applicable verified defect policy or the private assessment route
avoid: Treat the report as a proven defect or guarantee a refund
Apply change-of-mind exclusions to a possible defect without checking applicability
